summary: SPP amends its November 6 CHILLS tariff filing to add the omitted Schedule 14 and Incremental Market Efficiency Use revenue references to the Upper Missouri Zone rate sheet, keeping the February 1, 2027 effective date.
ask: Accept the November 6 filing as amended, with an effective date of February 1, 2027.

points.point: SPP may amend because no FERC or delegated order has issued on the November 6 filing.
points.quote: Amendment of the November 6 Filing is permitted because no Commission or delegated order has been issued in the docket.

points.point: SPP says it inadvertently omitted revisions to the Upper Missouri Zone rate sheet.
points.quote: SPP inadvertently omitted revisions to the rate sheet for the Upper Missouri Zone to add references to Schedule 14 and Incremental Market Efficiency Use revenues.

points.point: SPP keeps Attachment AU references on this sheet because the zone includes SPP East Region utilities.
points.quote: because the Upper Missouri Zone includes utilities in the SPP East Region.

points.point: SPP requests no other changes and the same effective date.
points.quote: SPP is not requesting any other amendments or modifications to the November 6 Filing.

throughLine.text: Technical amendment in SPP's ER27-432 docket extending CHILLS, its conditional large-load service, to the West Region; E-9 directs new services for flexible loads building on that framework.
